task.description: Write test/specs/REQ-151.md and test/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox_test.exs per WF-02_requirement_implementation.md Step 3. Claim this handoff by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only. Read lib/letflow/design/req151-lua-sandbox.md's test-plan section (the design specifies which paths to test) and lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex (the implementation) directly -- write tests against the real module, not against the design doc's prose alone.
acceptance_criteria: a test evaluates each of io.open, io.write, os.execute, os.exit, os.getenv, os.remove, os.rename, os.tmpname, load, loadfile, dofile, require, package, debug, and string.dump from INSIDE a script obtained from Sandbox.new/0 or new/1, asserting each is nil or raises

a test asserts the DEFAULT denials still hold when Sandbox.new/1 is called with any options this module supports, explicitly guarding the :sandboxed-replaces-defaults trap (at minimum os.execute and load still denied)
a test asserts coroutine == nil (or equivalent) inside a script, matching the design's explicit coroutine decision
a test confirms math/string/table (the intentionally allowed stdlib) remain reachable and functional from inside a script
every acceptance criterion in docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-151 entry has at least one test case that would fail if violated
no test depends on wall-clock time or unseeded randomness; tests are self-sufficient (no shared state, no ordering dependency)
